name: Jaimin Panchal
title: AI Full Stack Developer / Project Manager
headline: I build digital products. I think beyond code.
shortBio: AI Full Stack Developer / Project Manager focused on engineering, product thinking, and meaningful digital experiences.

children.text: I work at the point where engineering meets product decisions. My background is in building web applications with
PHP, Laravel, JavaScript, Vue.js and React
, backed by
MySQL and PostgreSQL
, and connected through REST APIs.

Today, as an AI Full Stack Developer and Project Manager at PrimeQA Solutions, my work spans writing code, shaping how systems are put together, and coordinating the delivery of the products those systems serve.
I care about software that is reliable first and impressive second, and about the decisions behind it: what to build, what to leave out, and how to keep a product maintainable after launch.

principles.title: Understand before building
principles.body: Most expensive bugs start as misunderstood requirements. Time spent on the problem is rarely wasted.

principles.title: Prefer boring, reliable systems
principles.body: Choose proven tools for the core and spend novelty where it creates real value for users.

principles.title: Make progress visible
principles.body: Small, demonstrable increments keep teams aligned and surface risks while they are still cheap.

principles.title: Own the outcome, not just the ticket
principles.body: Shipping is a milestone. A product that keeps working and keeps improving is the goal.

philosophy: Good engineering is a series of well-reasoned decisions. Code is how those decisions become real, so it should be clear enough that the next person can understand why.
currentFocus: Engineering and delivering AI-enabled products at PrimeQA Solutions.

heroSupporting: AI Full Stack Developer / Project Manager focused on engineering, product thinking, and meaningful digital experiences.
storyHeadline: More than code. It's about what we create.

storyBeats.title: An engineering foundation
storyBeats.body: A background in building web applications with PHP, Laravel, JavaScript and modern front-end frameworks, on top of relational databases.

storyBeats.title: Systems that hold up
storyBeats.body: An interest in how software behaves at scale: clean data models, predictable APIs, and code a team can keep changing.

storyBeats.title: AI, applied with judgement
storyBeats.body: Bringing AI capabilities into real products where they solve a concrete problem, not as a feature for its own sake.

storyBeats.title: Product and people
storyBeats.body: Working across roles to turn requirements into a plan, a plan into releases, and releases into something users rely on.

processSteps.title: Understand the problem
processSteps.body: Clarify who it is for, what success looks like, and which constraints are real.

processSteps.title: Define the solution
processSteps.body: Shape scope, trade-offs and a delivery plan before the first line of code.

processSteps.title: Architect the system
processSteps.body: Data model, boundaries and integrations chosen for clarity and room to grow.

processSteps.title: Build and iterate
processSteps.body: Ship in small increments, review often, and let feedback steer the next step.

processSteps.title: Validate and deliver
processSteps.body: Test against the original goal, release with care, and keep improving after launch.
